name: 214. Replicate file list cursor stays on the configured file endpoint (file-list-cursor)
description: The after cursor on GET /v1/files is caller input. For Replicate it used to be dialed as the complete next-page URL; it is now only the cursor query value on the configured base URL. A cursor that names another host or path, or that does not decode at all, is answered with a 400 before any request is built, so none of these cases reach the provider.

item.name: [EXPECT-400] replicate file list with a cursor link naming another host is refused - file-list-cursor

exec: // The stored cursor is a link to 127.0.0.1:9. Bifrost must refuse it instead of building a request to that host.
// Any other status (401/403/500/502) means the cursor was not refused by Bifrost.
pm.test('replicate file list with a cursor link naming another host is refused (file-list-cursor): status is 400', function () {
pm.test('replicate file list with a cursor link naming another host is refused (file-list-cursor): the 400 names the pagination cursor', function () {
pm.expect(body.error.error, 'the refusal reason stays in the gateway log and must not reach the client as error.error: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.undefined;
